basis: Frozen MD17-10 requires inert native HTML. HTML5 textarea/title are RCDATA: markup-like text is literal until their matching end tag. Static text has no execution, handler or external-resource authority. The original rejection confused tag membership with active behavior. Active tags outside RCDATA and active attributes remain denied.
